channel.description: Latest articles from UNFTR – Bias and Credibility (unftr.com)

item.title: Rubio Sells the Empire.
item.description: Marco Rubio’s defense of colonialism at the Munich Security Conference highlights the enduring imperial aspirations of the U.S. and Europe amid global geopolitical tensions and humanitarian crises.

item.title: Gerrymandering Through History.
item.description: Gerrymandering has undermined American democracy since the early days of the constitutional republic. From racial disenfranchisement to REDMAP’s high-tech manipulation, it blocks popular progressive policies despite their overwhelming public support.

item.title: So…About Chomsky.
item.description: Exploring the complex legacy of Noam Chomsky, his contributions to leftist ideology, and the impact of his controversial relationship with Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Pam Bondi and the Dow.
item.description: Pam Bondi defends the stock market amidst Epstein scandal fallout, but the Dow’s volatility reveals deeper economic issues and the need for justice for victims.

item.title: War in Iran and the Decline of the U.S. Empire.
item.description: Analysis of the U.S. and Israel’s war on Iran, its historical context, and the media’s biased framing, revealing the deeper implications and consequences.

item.title: John Goober Kennedy.
item.description: Senator John Kennedy downplays poverty in Louisiana, masking his elite background and lack of genuine effort to address the state’s economic challenges.

item.title: The Shajarah Tayyebe Massacre.
item.description: A horrific and unnecessary war began with a massacre of young school girls, and then the empire moved on.

item.title: BlackRocked.
item.description: BlackRock’s private-credit halt highlights the risks of democratizing finance, echoing the pitfalls of 1920s stock-market speculation for small investors.

item.title: The Iran War Could Wreck the Global Economy.
item.description: The Iran war threatens the global economy, impacting energy, food, and financial systems while straining the U.S. fiscal policy in unprecedented ways.

item.title: The Art of Trumpflation.
item.description: Explore the alarming rise in inflation driven by the recent PPI data, energy costs, and geopolitical tensions, signaling a potential economic crisis ahead.
